content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [article_no] module connected to an [product_name] expansion module to create an analogue output, but there's no measurable output between U1+ and M1. I'm not getting any analogue signal—did I miss something? I've uploaded the analog output test file to check. Does this combination ([article_no] with [product_name]) actually work together? The green LED on the [product_name] module is on. Looking forward to your suggestions, thanks! Best regards, [user_name]

Did you successfully transfer the program to the [product_name]? The forum upload shows a configuration with a [product_name] [article_no].Standard selected, not a [product_name] [version_no], which matches your specified module ([article_no]).

Hello [user_name], I've updated the program settings to [product_name] [version_no] as per your specified [article_no], uploaded it to the device (confirmed transfer and RUN status), see attached. Still, there's no output (set to 1000 = 10V). Do you have other ideas? Appreciate your help! Best regards, [user_name]
Is the [product_name] module provided with 24VDC? Is the contact slider fully engaged? Is the RUN/STOP LED showing green? What is the article number for the [product_name] module?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter problems generating analogue output when connecting specific modules, even after verifying configuration and matching hardware article numbers. Confirmation indicators like green LEDs do not guarantee proper function, causing uncertainty about module compatibility and setup validation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that correctly matching configuration settings and uploading the program should result in a functional analogue output when using compatible modules. They seek reliable integration between hardware and software without facing compatibility obstacles.
